From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA redlines received — Immutecorp (privacy counsel comments)

Thanks for the context, Alex. I reviewed Immutecorp’s redlines and drafted a counsel note (attached) with two recommended response paths and required evidence. High-level summary below — full comments are in privacy_counsel_comments.pdf.

Summary — primary negotiation points and recommended responses:

1) International transfers
- Recommend: Offer the EU SCCs + Redwood’s EU/UK Addendum (we should reference the latest Commission decision and include Module 2 where relevant). This is our low-friction path.
- If customer insists on a bespoke transfer clause, escalate to legal; it will add review time and risk.

2) Subprocessors
- Provide current subprocessor inventory (attached stub). We should commit to 30-days notice for new subprocessors and an opportunity for Customer to object on reasonable grounds (not a veto).
- For high-risk subprocessors (access to raw prompts/PII), propose a security attestation and SOC 2 Type II evidence rather than blanket liability increases.

3) Retention
- We can accept a hybrid retention approach: 5 years for backups (encrypted at rest), 1 year for derived analytics, with the option to shorten by contract amendment. Add a clean definition for "backups" vs "analytics derivatives."

4) Liability and indemnity
- Push back on unlimited processor liability; propose a cap tied to the fees under the DPA for the prior 12 months (standard commercial compromise). Flag any requests for broad consumer data remedies to Legal.

5) Evidence & execution
- Requested evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK), subprocessor inventory (vendor/country/function), dataflow diagram (high level), encryption description (at rest/in transit).
- Execution: recommend DocuSign envelope containing: final DPA (tracked), Subprocessor Annex (separate tabbed doc), and the EU/UK Addendum if we take the SCC route. We should send to Jane + Nick Harris as external counsel for signature; include corporate signatory fields.

Action items I propose now:
- Laura: review and mark any legal risk items (especially the transfer language and indemnity).
- Alex: share the subprocessor inventory (I’ve attached a draft subprocessor_inventory.xlsx).
- Alex/Laura: if we agree on SCC path, I’ll prepare the Addendum template and a short note explaining the technical controls for Immutecorp’s counsel.

Attachment: (stub) privacy_counsel_comments.pdf; (stub) subprocessor_inventory.xlsx
